verdict.rationale: Bento is an email marketing SaaS with AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack has no AI-training policy, opt-out setting, or no-training commitment. The data anonymization API (bento-docs-47) is an adjacent data-deletion control and does not count as preventing model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
